title: E-FND-0142: single-particle two-path coherence exists and is exact on the committed rule, correctly scoped against...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0142 in the foundations arena: single-particle two-path coherence exists and is exact on the committed rule, correctly scoped against the locking law: two branches of one species sum to exactly twice root three at one hundred fifty when aligned and exactly root three at ninety when one branch is kicked a single clock unit, so interference coherence between paths is exact while what the phase-number locking forbids is only the independent phase steering of a dressed composite, both statements now carried by their own experiments.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
